Premium deer tags are good for any species of deer legal to hunt in that unit/hunt area.

100 series controlled buck deer hunt. Tags = tags authorized; tags left after first choice go to 2nd-5th choice applicants (not shown). Filed under mule deer because neither the hunt name nor the regulations bag limit makes it a white-tailed-deer-only hunt; western Oregon deer hunts are for black-tailed deer.
